title: Nimble Aerated British Lemongrass Stew
description: This malty, aerated, festive British dish, featuring lemongrass, is perfect for special occasions. Serve warm in a cazuela, garnished with lemon slices and fresh herbs.
instructions: Heat the butter in a large cazuela over medium heat.
Melt 1 tablespoon of butter and sauté the lemongrass until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Add the vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the malted barley syrup and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Remove the lemongrass and stir in the heavy cream.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Simmer for an additional 2 minutes, or until heated through.
Serve warm, garnished with lemon slices and fresh herbs.
